# Shared NTFS Tracer components

Mail Evidence includes the NTFS disk image module and the WPF controls it uses from [NTFS Tracer](https://github.com/absolroot/NTFS-Tracer). This snapshot contains the revisions used by the Mail Evidence release, including mail file search. The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included here. Dependency notices and the LGPL libewf source and build instructions are in [EvidenceImage](modules/EvidenceImage/).
